Class HttpRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.net.http.HttpRequest
public final class HttpRequest extends Object
The board-side java.net.http.HttpRequest: an immutable request for one URI, built once and sent as often as needed. See the package description for the subset.

Its headers are kept as the bytes the board sends, at most 512 of them, so a request without headers allocates no header buffer. As in the JDK, Connection, Content-Length, Expect, Host and Upgrade are set by the client and rejected here.
